title: Karnataka Appellate Tribunal is looking to hire Law clerks cum Research Assistants and Court Typists cum Stenographers
description: Karnataka Appellate Tribunal (KAT) is looking hire Law clerks cum Research Assistants and Court Typists cum Stenographers in Bengaluru on honorarium basis.Applications are invited through mail or Registrar's office from eligible candidates for selection to 10 posts of Law Clerks-cum-Research Assistant and 05 post of Court Typist cum stenographer that may arise as on the date of issuance of final selection proceedings.The following are the terms and conditions for selection of Law Clerks-cum-Rese
